svg.text: FLOODING THE PATCH'S GRADIENT FROM TWO HAND-DRAWN MARKERS
the impulse (r2, c1) floods at 430, not 0: the water has to climb its rim of 430 to reach it
the two regions first touch at 640, the step: region 1 takes c2, region 2 takes c3
numbers in the cells are the relief, the Sobel magnitude from Part 8
